text.content:
Leader of the crew.

Role: Solo; crew leader
Known for: Heavy chrome; two years in NUSA SpecOps

Spoilers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. Raised in Portland, Maine, by a jazz singer, Maine grew from a sickly kid into an underground boxer and club bouncer. A fight with NUSA SpecOps soldiers got him a job offer from them; two years of burning villages in South America ended his taste for it.

He turned down an old unit buddy, Solomon Reed, who wanted help building a NUSA spy network in Night City, and started his own edgerunner crew instead.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.39
